description: Lambda function configuration - maps directories to AWS Lambda function names for StrideLux e-commerce platform

products.description: Product catalog CRUD — GET /products (public), GET /products/{id} (public), POST/PUT/DELETE /products (admin only). Reads/writes stridelux-products table. Handles category/brand/search/inStock filters, treats 'All' as no filter.

orders.description: Order lifecycle for customers and admins — POST /orders, GET /orders (own orders, excludes pending_payment), GET /orders/{orderId}, GET /admin/orders (full scan), PUT /admin/orders/{orderId}/status. Valid statuses: pending, processing, shipped, out-for-delivery, delivered, cancelled. Reads/writes stridelux-orders, reads stridelux-products.

admin.description: Admin dashboard — GET /admin/dashboard (aggregated stats), GET /admin/reports, GET /admin/users (returns customers[] and employees[]), POST/PUT/DELETE /admin/employees (also calls Cognito AdminCreateUser + AdminAddUserToGroup), GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /admin/coupons. Reads/writes stridelux-orders, stridelux-products, stridelux-users, stridelux-coupons. Requires COGNITO_USER_POOL_ID env var. Sends transactional emails via SES v2.

users.description: Customer profile self-service — GET/PUT /users/me, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /users/me/addresses. Addresses stored as embedded List of Maps on the user record in stridelux-users (NOT a separate table). GET returns addresses newest-first (.reverse()). POST deduplicates by street+postalCode and caps at 5 addresses per user.

payments.description: Stripe integration — POST /payments/checkout-session (public, no Cognito authorizer — manually decodes JWT from Authorization header for logged-in users), POST /payments/webhook (public, verified via Stripe signature), POST /coupons/validate (public). Server-side price recomputation via BatchGetItem on stridelux-products (never trusts body.total). Webhook updates order to processing/paid, decrements stockCount in stridelux-products. Sends order confirmation emails via SES v2. Reads/writes stridelux-orders, stridelux-coupons, stridelux-products.

cart.description: Cart and wishlist persistence — GET/POST /cart, PUT /cart/{productId}, DELETE /cart/{productId}, DELETE /cart (BatchWriteItem wipe for post-order clear), GET/POST /wishlist, DELETE /wishlist/{productId}. Uses stridelux-cart-wishlist table with composite key userId (PK) + itemId (SK). itemId format: CART#{productId}#{size} or WISHLIST#{productId}. Enriches responses with live product data via BatchGetItem on stridelux-products.

post-confirmation.description: Cognito trigger — NOT invoked via API Gateway. Attached to both Post Confirmation (PostConfirmation_ConfirmSignUp) and Post Authentication (PostAuthentication_Authentication) triggers on stridelux-user-pool. Post Confirmation: PutItem to stridelux-users with ConditionExpression attribute_not_exists(userId). Post Authentication: checks if record exists first — if missing creates complete record, if exists UpdateItem to sync name/phone/email from Cognito. Must always return the event object back to Cognito.
